formulas.formula: Bookings, occupancy and true profit for your Airbnb and vacation rentals.
Setup: your business name, the year, your usual platform fee and an occupancy goal.
Listings: each place you rent, its platform fee and what you pay for each cleaning.
Bookings: check-in, check-out, listing, channel and what the guest paid. Leave Platform fee blank to use the listing's %.
Expenses: mortgage, utilities, supplies and repairs. Leave Listing blank for shared costs.
Monthly, Listing Stats, Channels, Calendar and Dashboard update on their own.
Nights booked divided by nights available. Nights are counted in the month they happen.
Money counts in the check-in month, like most payout reports.
Average daily rate: room revenue divided by nights booked.
Room revenue divided by every night in the year. Shows how hard the place works.
Red = a loss or a typo.
Here's to five-star stays and full calendars.

Up to 5 places. Blank fee = the usual fee from Setup.
One row per stay. Platform fee blank = the listing's % of room revenue plus cleaning fee. Put 0 for direct bookings.
